Hello community,

The next Java ILP community call will be this Wednesday, Oct 23rd, at 10am PST.

Agenda

  1. Introductions
  2. Discuss Quilt v1.0.1 Patch Release (see here).
  3. Discuss open Quilt issues & PRs
  4. Q&A, misc issues
